findings.statement: Individual/sole proprietor, so no South Carolina entity registration is expected for 'Guffey's Mobile Mechanic'. The SC Secretary of State register was not searched.
findings.establishes: No registration expected; nothing checked or contradicted.

findings.statement: An independent auto-repair directory lists 'Guffey's Mobile Mechanic' at 2557 Sniders Hwy, Walterboro, SC 29488 (Colleton County, which contains Green Pond) with phone (843) 898-6272 and Mon-Sat hours. A Nextdoor business page 'Guffey's Mobile Mechanic - Walterboro, SC' also surfaced in search results but could not be loaded.
findings.establishes: A business by this exact name exists in the stated area with a local 843 phone number.

findings.statement: Representative identity and bank-account ownership cannot be verified from public sources. The statement descriptor is a personal name (Teresa Fletcher) that differs from the business name 'Guffey's', and no loaded public listing names either a Guffey or a Fletcher as operator; the relationship is unconfirmed but not contradicted.
findings.establishes: No public source confirms or contradicts the stated owner.

findings.statement: No website provided; the only contact is a Gmail address matching the business name. The directory listing shows a phone number but no website, consistent with the account data.
findings.establishes: No website to verify; public listing confirms a phone contact only.

findings.statement: The loaded listing describes the business as an auto repair operation performing diagnostics, oil changes, general automotive repair, suspension/steering and fleet services, coherent with MCC 7538 (automotive service shops) and the stated mobile-mechanic product description.
findings.establishes: Observable service offering matches the MCC and product description.

findings.statement: No dated, independent review history could be confirmed: the directory page shows two 2013/2014 reviews but they reference a different shop and are evidently template content. No complaints or fraud reports were found.
findings.establishes: No reliable evidence of operating tenure; no negative reports.

evidenceNeeded: Reconcile the descriptor name (Teresa Fletcher) with the KYC representative and the Guffey business name.
Set the statement descriptor to the business name so cardholders recognise the charge.
summary: Guffey's Mobile Mechanic has a genuine public footprint in the stated area: an independent repair directory lists it by exact name in Walterboro, Colleton County, SC with a local phone number, and a Nextdoor business page also appears in search. The listed services match MCC 7538 and the product description. The statement descriptor 'TERESA FLETCHER' is a personal name unconnected to 'Guffey' in any public source; not a contradiction, but it should be reconciled against the KYC name on file.
